config_changes: No Solr configset or application source changes.
Validation harness used SOLR_HEAP=256m and Docker --memory 768m --memory-swap 768m to keep the local proof bounded.

steps: Created a disposable default core named doscore via the official Docker helper: solr-precreate doscore.

trigger.request_shape: POST http://127.0.0.1:28983/solr/doscore/select; body starts with q=%2A%3A%2A and appends many attacker-controlled pNNNNNN=<value> form parameters.
trigger.loop_variable: form body bytes and parameter count
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single local HTTP client, one request per body-size step; 128MiB returned HTTP 200 and 256MiB disconnected while the target JVM aborted with Java heap OOM.

utilization_conditions.summary: 匿名 HTTP 客户端在官方 Solr Docker 默认安全关闭部署中，对默认 core 的 /select 发送 form-url-encoded POST，可在 SOLR_HEAP=1g、2GiB 容器复测下由 256MiB 表单请求触发目标 JVM Java heap space OOM 并导致服务退出。
limits_or_mitigations: Validation was repeated with SOLR_HEAP=1g; larger production heaps raise the required body-size threshold.
Default _default configset did not enforce a small formdataUploadLimitInKB in this deployment path.
Reverse-proxy/client body limits, Solr requestParsers formdataUploadLimitInKB, authentication, rate limits, or per-client quotas can block or raise the attack cost.
The proof bound the Docker container to 768MiB only to avoid host impact; the failure signal was Java heap OOM, not Docker OOMKilled.
not_affected_when: Solr HTTP endpoints are not reachable by low-trust clients.
A strict form-url-encoded body-size limit rejects the request before SolrRequestParsers materializes parameters.
Authentication/authorization, reverse proxy controls, or rate limits prevent anonymous large POST requests.

static_traceability.source: External POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded body to default core handlers such as /solr/{core}/select or /solr/{core}/query
static_traceability.sink: SolrRequestParsers.parseFormDataContent accumulates key/value bytes, optional charset buffer entries, decoded strings, and MultiMapSolrParams arrays before handler execution
static_traceability.driver: form body byte length, parameter count, key length, and value length
missing_static_evidence: No dynamic heap slope or service unavailability measurement was present in the static result.
Repository-local Jetty config does not prove absence of external reverse-proxy body limits.

notes: 2026-06-30 strict retest raised SOLR_HEAP from the earlier 256m proof to 1g and Docker memory to 2g.
The 128MiB form POST returned HTTP 200 with heap.max=1073741824; the 256MiB form POST disconnected and the container exited with code 134.
The retained container log contains Aborting due to java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space and the fatal JVM OOM report.
